description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called SystemUIModes that demonstrates various ways to manipulate the system UI visibility and window attributes such as fullscreen, overscan, translucent status/navigation, and action modes. It includes inner classes, methods for handling UI changes, and event listeners to modify and update the UI state.

classes.name: SystemUIModes
classes.description: Main activity class that provides UI controls and demonstrations for system UI modifications.

inner_classes.name: IV
inner_classes.description: Custom ImageView subclass that implements system UI visibility change listener and manages action modes.

methods.name: setFullscreen
methods.description: Enables or disables fullscreen mode by setting or clearing the FLAG_FULLSCREEN window flag.

methods.name: setOverscan
methods.description: Enables or disables overscan mode by setting or clearing the FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_OVERSCAN window flag.

methods.name: setTranslucentStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables translucent status bar by setting or clearing the FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_STATUS window flag.

methods.name: setTranslucentNavigation
methods.description: Enables or disables translucent navigation bar by setting or clearing the FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_NAVIGATION window flag.

methods.name: refreshSizes
methods.description: Updates the display metrics and view size information displayed on the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI controls, event listeners, and UI state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, sets up search and share actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection for toggling action bar tabs visibility.

methods.name: updateCheckControls
methods.description: Syncs checkbox states with current system UI visibility flags.

methods.name: updateSystemUi
methods.description: Applies system UI visibility flags based on checkbox states.

methods.name: clearActionMode
methods.description: Clears the custom action mode state.
